$description: ui-kit geometry. Everything derives from u (size, 2–12px), B (border) and s (radius scale). $value is resolved at u=4, B=0, s=1; com.massimo.formula gives the rule and com.massimo.bySize the value at every size.

u.$description: all · unit u · size="2|2.25|2.5|3|3.5|4|4.5"; theme default 4

B.$description: all · border B · whole px, 0..u/2; lives inside padding, never added to height

s.$description: all · curvature scale s · theme radius-scale, 0..3

k.$description: all · corner shape k · theme corner-shape; 1 round, 2 squircle, 0 bevel, -1 scoop

pad.$description: composite padding in units of u (theme parameter pad-composite)

gap.$description: composite gap in units of u (theme parameter gap-composite)

pad.$description: group padding in units of u (theme parameter pad-group)

gap.$description: group gap in units of u (theme parameter gap-group)

pad.$description: collection padding in units of u (theme parameter pad-collection)

gap.$description: collection gap in units of u (theme parameter gap-collection)

pad.$description: tile padding in units of u (theme parameter pad-tile)

gap.$description: tile gap in units of u (theme parameter gap-tile)

pad.$description: card padding in units of u (theme parameter pad-card)

gap.$description: card gap in units of u (theme parameter gap-card)

pad.$description: panel padding in units of u (theme parameter pad-panel)

gap.$description: panel gap in units of u (theme parameter gap-panel)

pad.$description: region padding in units of u (theme parameter pad-region)

gap.$description: region gap in units of u (theme parameter gap-region)

pad.$description: page padding in units of u (theme parameter pad-page)

gap.$description: page gap in units of u (theme parameter gap-page)

padding.$description: button, input, select · padding · border + padding = 1u

slot.$description: button, option · slot (leading / contents / trailing) min size · empty slots hidden; icon-only button = 8u square

paddingInline.$description: button, option · contents inline padding beside a slot

lineHeight.$description: button, option · contents line height (single-line controls: button, option, input, select) · 1.2 × (10px + u); the 6u cap applies below u = 2.5

between.$description: button, option, input control, select trigger, tag, chip, choices · gap between adjacent text parts (prefix | label | suffix) · construction pattern [leading] [prefix] [contents] [suffix] [trailing]; text-run edges: 1u beside a slot, 2u bare (tag/chip 1u, choices 0)

md.$description: icons in slots · icon md (default) · capped by slot below u~2.2

lg.$description: icons in slots · icon lg · capped by slot below u~2.9

fill.$description: icons in slots · icon fill · object-fit cover, centered

radius.$description: button, input, select · radius · soft curvature, capped at half height
fill slot · fill slot radius · nested inside the control radius

open.$description: button, option · label padding on a side without leading/trailing · text-only: 2u both sides; leading only: 1u start, 2u end

paddingInline.$description: input · text inline padding · host 1u + contents 2u (button label rule); select: contents 2u | 1u, then the 6u trailing chevron slot, then u - B

paddingEnd.$description: select trigger · end padding · chevron occupies a trailing 6u slot

icon.$description: select trigger · chevron icon · all caret-* icons in slots use sm

edge.$description: listbox, segmented, popup · edge distance D · the composite padding level

gap.$description: listbox, segmented, popup · gap between options

radius.$description: ui-group · max radius · concentric with a 3u control in the corner; capped at half height
ui-collection · max radius · concentric with a 3u control in the corner; capped at half height
ui-tile · max radius · concentric with a 3u control in the corner; capped at half height
ui-card · max radius · concentric with a 3u control in the corner; capped at half height
ui-panel · max radius · square: meets the viewport edge
ui-region · max radius · square: meets the viewport edge
ui-page · max radius · square: meets the viewport edge

maxWidth.$description: ui-page · max width · px at a 16px root; centered; page({ width }) overrides

box.$description: checkbox, radio, switch · box height · in the 6u leading slot

paddingStart.$description: checkbox, radio, switch · label start padding · label lands 1.5u from the box

radius.$description: checkbox · radius · radio and switch stay round

track.$description: range, progress · track thickness · radius min(3u * s, 2u)

radius.$description: range, progress · track and thumb radius · range fill = ratio * (width - 4u) + 4u
swatch · radius · square inside a palette
palette · radius · swatches attached, no gap

paddleInset.$description: swiper · paddle inset · paddles are 8u icon buttons

dot.$description: swiper · dot · 4u hit area, u gap

height.$description: chip · height · cap: never taller than a control (bites below u = 2.4)

font.$description: chip · font size · same as controls

slot.$description: chip · slot (leading / contents / trailing) min size · equals tag height (uncapped range)

lineHeight.$description: chip · line height · tag: same rule with the tag font and slot; badge: min(1.2 × 10px, badge height)

md.$description: chip · icon md · sm/lg/fill as for controls, against the chip slot

radius.$description: chip · radius · tag and badge: same formula with their height

height.$description: tag · height · one u below chip

slot.$description: tag · slot min size · equals badge height (uncapped range)

height.$description: badge · height · one u below tag

bareEdge.$description: badge · label padding at a bare edge · ch = one digit (value shown for ch = 5.5px); keeps a one-character badge round; beside a slot 0.25u

padding.$description: badge, tag, chip · padding · host padding for badge, tag and chip; the label wrapper carries the rest

bareEdge.$description: tag, chip · label padding at a bare edge · half the control (2u); beside a slot 0.5u; text parts 0.5u apart

slotEdge.$description: tag, chip · label padding beside a slot

minWidth.$description: badge, tag, chip · min width · value shown for badge; a single character is a circle
